name: Reformer Pilates
summary: How expats start reformer Pilates in Singapore — intro packages, instructor credentials, heat/humidity class timing, and rehab vs fitness studio fit.
body:
Reformer studios are dense across town; quality varies from physio-led rehab to high-energy group flow. Beginners should learn footbar safety and spring changes before chasing advanced choreography.

## Formats
- Intro private sessions on reformer
- Semi-private duets
- Group reformer classes
- Clinical / physio-adjacent rehab Pilates
- Mat crossover homework between sessions

Peak evenings book out — lunch and early mornings stay calmer.

## How to choose
Prefer instructors who ask about injuries and pregnancy history before loading springs. Ask whether grips and socks are included. Confirm cancellation windows — no-show fees stack quickly.

## Practical tip
Bring grip socks and a water bottle on day one. Midday humidity makes slippery feet the main beginner risk, not the springs.
